title: Known Bounds for the Hadwiger-Nelson Problem
abstract: Formalizes the currently known bounds 5 <= chi(R^2) <= 7 for the chromatic number of the Euclidean plane. The upper bound constructs an explicit Isbell-style seven-coloring. The lower bound checks Parts' 481-vertex coloring certificate, develops a finite doubled triangular-lattice forcing gadget, proves its exact Euclidean embedding, and closes the four-color contradiction with a spindle construction. The exact chromatic number remains open.

informal.HadwigerNelsonBounds.hadwiger_nelson_kno: The chromatic number of the unit-distance graph on the Euclidean plane lies between five and seven, inclusive.
informal.HadwigerNelsonBounds.unitDistanceGraph_n: The unit-distance graph on the Euclidean plane admits no proper coloring with four colors.
informal.HadwigerNelsonBounds.chromaticNumber_le_: An explicit Isbell-style coloring proves that the unit-distance graph on the Euclidean plane is colorable with seven colors.
